title: Eddie Morris, Zooey Sullen and Zooey Robinson
summary: After Zooey Sullen was killed, Eddie Morris played trombone with Kid Punch; Zooey Robinson was another trombonist.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: What about Eddie Morris? Who did he play with? Well, Eddie Morris, well after Zooey died, Zooey got killed, you know, but Eddie Morris went to a tram on with Kid Punch.
Zooey, Zooey. Zooey Sullen got killed, you know.
Eddie Morris went to play with Kid Punch until Kid Punch gave Wentz a call.
I thought maybe you were talking about Zooey Robinson.

No, no, Zooey Robinson was used to play tram on at Larry's. Oh, yeah. He went over to the rubber show. And when Zooey left, then Johnny Lindsay came and took Zooey's place. I see. Zooey went to Chicago. Johnny came and played in Zooey's place. Johnny Lindsay.
